book.technomancy.technobasics: RF is represented by Forge Energy (FE). Gunpowder ignores redstone, dust selects a high signal, and a torch selects a low signal; changing this setting exchanges the installed item. Optional Thermal and Mekanism recipes are selected in that order. Thermal component tiers no longer exist as separate items: energy cells and RF coils are their current equivalents. The reservoir, glass pane and fusion focus have no survival recipe in the 0.12.5 baseline.
book.technomancy.teslacoil: Use the coupler on a coil, then on sources; sneak-use on the coil clears its links. Transfers remain within the loaded dimension. Upgraded coils ignore redstone input and emit a signal while a destination has space. Refused transfers are retained in the coil.
book.technomancy.nodegenerator: A fabricator reserves a vertical 3 by 3 plane. Place two facing each other with five free blocks between them; the node forms one block above the midpoint. Wand activation charges for 200 ticks before committing stored essentia and FE. Costs are calculated before draining. Blocked or unloaded structures pause or abort without consuming the charge.
book.technomancy.processor: Each magic system can purify an ore twice. Smelting yields 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 ingots across six stages. Modern ore and raw-material tags identify available metals; the output retains its metal and completed processing passes. Botania and Blood Magic provide the other two systems.
book.technomancy.rod_electric: The energized rod draws FE from energy-extracting items in the main inventory. One centivis costs 100 FE. A technoturge scepter can also receive FE directly from a charger; simulated transfers do not change its NBT.
book.technomancy.eldritchconsumer: The six work areas are shown in the machine interface. World-height operations use the current dimension limits and advance in bounded batches. Protected or unloaded blocks are skipped. Stored essentia, energy, upgrades and pending transfers travel with the dropped machine.
book.technomancy.rituals: Place matching crystal pillars at the four corners, each three blocks tall. Ring distances from the catalyst are 1, 3 and 5 blocks. Sneak-right-click the empty-handed catalyst, use a wand, or apply redstone to start. The ritual tome shows the sixteen registered layouts. Original metadata is preserved: earth/fire/water/light/dark recipes use black/white/red/green/blue dye respectively, while their crystals appear green/red/blue/black/white.
book.technomancy.existence: The existence gem is crafted empty. Keep it in your inventory and kill creatures to charge it; machine recipes require a full gem. Burners sacrifice nearby creatures. Pylons draw power from sources within seven blocks horizontally and one vertically, and relay it to consumers. A fertiliser belongs two blocks below its crops; a harvester belongs at crop level. The dynamic burner consumes 10000 FE per sacrifice.
book.technomancy.botania: The hippie dynamo receives mana bursts and draws from pools on the same level within four blocks and generates FE. The mana fabricator reverses the process. Use the mana exchanger to condense mana into a fluid or recover mana from it. The botanical purifier uses mana to process ores, at most twice per ore. The mana coil is infused in a mana pool with 3000 mana.
book.technomancy.bloodmagic: The blood dynamo consumes liquid life essence and produces FE. A blood fabricator converts FE into life essence. A sanguine infuser uses the soul network of the player who placed it. A divination sigil inspects the blood dynamo. Sacrificial ingots and life coils use a tier 2 altar, 1000 LP; the blood dynamo uses tier 3 and 10000 LP.
ritual.technomancy.basics.description: Four pillars, three crystals each. Ring distances: 1, 3, 5. Sneak-use the core with an empty hand to activate. Detailed recipes are in the Thaumonomicon.
ritual.technomancy.existence.description: Full existence gems craft machines. Treasure villagers are disabled by default, as in 0.12.5. Extracting from the wrong target can cause an explosion.
